    • RestStoreConfig

      public RestStoreConfig(boolean enabled, Map<String,RestServiceEndpointConfig> stores, String undefined)
      Creates a new RestStoreConfig instance.
      Parameters:
      enabled - Enables the REST store sub-system.
      Default: false
      stores - Named endpoints (max 3), matched against IDMQuery.name. Each entry carries its own baseUrl, authentication, truststore and network (connect/response timeouts).
      undefined - Placeholder fallback value when an input attribute is not available.
      Default: UNDEF
